facts.fact: TCRA reports the industry-average pay-as-you-go data tariff at TZS 9.35 per MB (per-megabyte price, average across operators) for the quarter ending September 2025, unchanged from June 2025.
facts.system: TCRA industry-average data tariff (pay as you go)

facts.fact: TCRA reports the industry-average bundle data tariff at TZS 2.08 per MB (per-megabyte price, average across operators' bundles, used by 99.9% of users) for the quarter ending September 2025, down 2.0% from TZS 2.12 in June 2025.
